page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, left and right of a central rule. The left column has a centred letter heading ("נ נ") about halfway down. The catchword sits at the lower right, below the right column. The printed page number and running head are at the top.

main_text.p: נִבְרֵאת [?] creata fuisti, præt. Niph. 2. sing. fem. Rad. בָּרָא.
וְנִבְרְחָה [?] & fugiamus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בָּרַח.
וְנְבָרֵךְ [?] benedicemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. & נִבְרָכָה genua flectamus, (pro נִבְרֵךְ) fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בָּרַךְ.
וְנִבְרְכוּ [?] & benedicentur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. בָּרַךְ.
נָבָר purificatus, (contracte pro נִבְרָךְ,) Part. Niph. sing. m. Rad. בָּרַר.
נְבַשֵּׁל coquemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. R. בָּשַׁל.
נִגְאָלָה polluta est, præt. Niph. 3. sf. à s. m. נִגְאַל pollutus est, ut & נִגְאָלוּ contaminati sunt, Thren. 4. 14. comp. ex præt. Niph. & præt.
נָאַל Paal [?], 3. pl. Rad. נָאַל redemit.
לִנְגֶּבָה ad meridiem, No. נֶגֶב, Rad. cum præf. & ה locali.
וַנַּגֵּד & indicavimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. נָגַד.
נַגִּיד indicabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. נָגַד.
נִגְרְשׁוּ [?] succisi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָגַר [?].
נֹגָהֶם splendor ipsorum, No. sing. m. נֹגַהּ, aff. & לִנְגֹהוֹת ad splendores, No. pl. fæm. præf. Rad. נָגַהּ splenduit.
נָגוֹהוּ [?] tonsi fuerunt, Nah. 1. 12. præt. Niph. 3. pl. pro נָגְזוּ, Rad. גָּזַז.
נָגוֹלוּ convoluti sunt, Jes. 34. 4. pro נָגְלוּ, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. גָּלַל.
נָגַע plagâ affectus, Paul Kal, s. m. R. נָגַע.
נָגוּף percutiendo, Jud. 20. 39. Infin. Niph. pro הִנָּגֵף, Rad. נָגַף.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and some roots are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The running head letters are doubtful. The page number "82" is at the top left and may be partly obscured. The catchword "נגולה" is at the lower right. The Latin "Paal" may be "Pual" and is marked [?]. Some Latin words in the right column ("succisi sunt") and the Hebrew form beside them were not fully legible.
